title: Mortgage assistance application: documents by hardship and income type
use_when: Pick this when a borrower with payment difficulties is applying to the servicer for mortgage assistance (loss mitigation) on a loan owned by Fannie Mae or Freddie Mac.
note: Items follow Fannie Mae/Freddie Mac Form 710 and Fannie Mae Servicing Guide D2-2-05. The form asks for no hardship documents for unemployment, reduced income, increased housing expenses or a disaster, and no income documents for unemployment benefits. Servicers of loans with other owners or insurers use their own forms.

form-710.name: Fannie Mae/Freddie Mac Form 710, Mortgage Assistance Application (effective 12.11.24), copy published with the Freddie Mac Single-Family Seller/Servicer Guide

servicing-guide.name: Fannie Mae Servicing Guide D2-2-05, Receiving a Borrower Response Package (06/09/2021)

situations.disability-illness: Is the hardship a long-term or permanent disability or serious illness of a borrower or dependent family member?
situations.divorce: Is the hardship a divorce or legal separation?
situations.separation-unmarried: Is the hardship a separation of borrowers who are not married or in a civil union or domestic partnership?
situations.death: Is the hardship the death of a borrower or of the primary or secondary wage earner?
situations.relocation-military: Is the hardship a distant transfer of an active-duty service member?
situations.relocation-job: Is the hardship a distant employment transfer or new job in another location?
situations.other-hardship: Is the hardship something the form does not list?
situations.wages: Does the borrower have wages, salary, overtime, commission, tip or bonus income?
situations.self-employed: Does the borrower have self-employment income?
situations.benefits: Does the borrower have Social Security, pension, disability, death benefit, adoption assistance, housing allowance or other public assistance income?
situations.rental: Does the borrower have rental income?
situations.investment: Does the borrower have investment or insurance income?
situations.other-income: Does the borrower have other income, including alimony, child support or separate maintenance they choose to have considered?
situations.transcript-requested: Has the servicer asked for a tax transcript authorization?

items.label: Completed and signed Mortgage Assistance Application (Form 710)
items.detail: Every section filled in; the form asks for the last four digits of each borrower's Social Security number. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Updated income documents if earlier ones become too old
items.detail: Income documents must be no more than 90 days old when the servicer first finds the package complete.

items.label: Signed IRS Form 4506-C
items.detail: Asked by the servicer to reconcile inconsistencies between the application and the income documents, or when Fannie Mae requests it. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Written statement from the borrower, or other documentation verifying the disability or illness
items.detail: The form says detailed medical information and information from a medical provider are not required.

items.label: Final divorce decree or final separation agreement
Recorded quitclaim deed
items.detail: Alternative: a legally binding agreement showing the non-occupying borrower or co-borrower has given up all rights to the property.

items.label: Death certificate
items.detail: Alternative: an obituary or newspaper article reporting the death.

items.label: Permanent Change of Station (PCS) orders or a letter showing the transfer
Signed offer letter or employer notice showing the transfer to a new location
items.detail: A written explanation is used if employer documentation does not apply.

items.label: Documentation of the amount of any relocation assistance provided
Written explanation of the hardship, with any relevant documentation
Most recent pay stub, with documentation of year-to-date earnings if the pay stub does not show them
items.detail: Alternative: two most recent bank statements showing the income deposit amounts. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Two most recent bank statements showing the self-employment income deposits
items.detail: Alternatives: the most recent signed and dated quarterly or year-to-date profit and loss statement; the most recent complete and signed business tax return; or the most recent complete and signed individual federal income tax return. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Two most recent bank statements showing the benefit deposit amounts
items.detail: Alternative: award letters or other documentation showing the amount and frequency of the benefits. Applies to taxable and non-taxable benefits. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Two most recent bank statements showing receipt of rent
items.detail: Alternative: the two most recent deposited rent checks. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Two most recent investment statements
items.detail: Alternative: two most recent bank statements showing receipt of the income. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Two most recent bank statements showing receipt of the income
items.detail: Alternative: other documentation showing the amount and frequency of the income. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.
